description: Frozen policies; parameters fixed before evaluation. Non-nominal cases are stress tests.

noisy_csi.description: CSI error beta increases from 0.1 to 0.3.

tight_deadline.description: Same geometry with a 30-second deadline (30 one-second steps).

crossing.description: Equal-altitude intersecting paths; unseen start and goal geometry.

shifted_goals.description: Unseen, closer goals within the same flight volume.

reverse_goals.description: Reverse-direction goals withheld as an explicit extrapolation test.

wide_bounds.description: Only enlarge bounds; keep starts, goals, time, and speed fixed.

fast_speed.description: Only increase speed limit from 5 to 8 m/s; acceleration remains 5 m/s².

wide_fast.description: Both bounds and speed changed; all other task parameters fixed.

prediction_only.description: Nominal geometry, identical prior, prediction only: no measurement updates.

bs_only.description: Nominal geometry, BS updates only: isolate value of UAV measurement fusion.
